name: api-qa-inspector
description: Chrome extension and Playwright runner that detect duplicate, unexpected and regressed API calls.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @api-qa/extension build:e2e && pnpm --filter @api-qa/extension validate:manifest:e2e && playwright test
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @api-qa/extension build:e2e && playwright test --grep @smoke
scripts.baselines:update: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && UPDATE_BASELINES=1 playwright test -c apps/runner/playwright.config.ts --grep @baseline
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm icons:check && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm build && pnpm validate:manifest
scripts.security: pnpm security:secrets && pnpm security:lockfile && pnpm security:audit && pnpm test:security
scripts.package:extension: pnpm build && pnpm validate:manifest && node scripts/package-extension.ts
